tone: Reverent, grounded and epic; grief, hope and human dignity without spectacle.

depictionRules.text: God the Father has no human face or body; use light, cloud, fire or radiance. The Holy Spirit is dove, wind or flame, never human.
Treat battles, death and crucifixion seriously; avoid lingering gore.
No sexually explicit content; non-sexual nudity may follow the text.
Show all peoples with dignity, without ethnic or religious caricature.
Visionary creatures follow the text, strange and fearsome rather than comic.

eras.label: Creation and the patriarchs
eras.people: Ancient Near Eastern households, herders and farmers.
eras.dress: Simple wool or linen wraps, tunics and sandals.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Wild land, tents, wells, altars and mud-brick towns as the text allows.
eras.technology: Hand tools, herding, farming and weighed metal; no modern objects.

eras.label: Egypt, wilderness and settlement
eras.people: Israelites, Egyptians and neighboring ancient peoples.
eras.dress: Woven tunics, cloaks, Egyptian linen and priestly garments.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Tents, tabernacle, Egyptian palaces and fortified towns.
eras.technology: Bronze tools, chariots and early iron; no modern objects.

eras.label: Kingdoms, exile and return
eras.people: Israelites and neighboring Levantine, Mesopotamian and Persian peoples.
eras.dress: Tunics, cloaks, court robes, priestly linen and period armor.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Villages, palaces, temples, city gates and exile settlements.
eras.technology: Iron and bronze tools, chariots, siege works and scrolls; no modern objects.

eras.label: Roman Judea and the early church
eras.people: Jewish and Gentile Mediterranean communities under Roman rule.
eras.dress: Tunics, cloaks, priestly robes and Roman military clothing.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Stone villages, synagogues, temple, fishing boats and Roman cities.
eras.technology: Oil lamps, sail and oar, roads, coins and papyrus; no modern objects.

eras.label: Visionary heaven and renewal
eras.people: Seers, heavenly beings and the redeemed as described.
eras.dress: Robes and garments with the text's colors and materials.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Thrones, altars, glass-like sea and jeweled city as described.
eras.technology: Ancient lamps, trumpets, harps, swords and sailing ships; no modern objects.
